scope: Ten primary papers checked through official proceedings or author preprints for selected related-work claims.
Thirteen manufacturer bibliography entries checked against existing archived metadata: four prior-source entries plus nine entries representing eight new source families.
This is a bibliography and selected-claims audit, not a new equipment-fact review, independent human acceptance, systematic literature survey or experimental replication.

academic_papers.title: {KQA Pro}: A Dataset with Explicit Compositional Programs for Complex Question Answering over Knowledge Base
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Cao, Shulin and Shi, Jiaxin and Pan, Liangming and Nie, Lunyiu and Xiang, Yutong and Hou, Lei and Li, Juanzi and He, Bin and Zhang, Hanwang
academic_papers.venue_or_institution: Proceedings of the 60th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
accessed_scope: Paper task description and KoPL function appendix, PDF page 15
claims_used_in_chapter: KQA Pro provides about 120,000 questions with explicit KoPL programs and SPARQL queries.
KoPL includes attribute, qualifier, set and comparison operations.

academic_papers.title: {Qwen2.5} Technical Report
accessed_scope: Section 2 architecture/model-size table and post-training overview
claims_used_in_chapter: The report covers multiple open-weight model sizes, including a 3B model, and instruction post-training.
limitations: Corporate author Qwen Team follows the report byline.
No general 128K-context claim is applied to the 3B model.

academic_papers.title: {LoRA}: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Hu, Edward J. and Shen, Yelong and Wallis, Phillip and Allen-Zhu, Zeyuan and Li, Yuanzhi and Wang, Shean and Wang, Lu and Chen, Weizhu
accessed_scope: Section 4 low-rank update and scaling formulation
claims_used_in_chapter: LoRA freezes original weights and learns low-rank update matrices.
limitations: OpenReview full page was challenged during this audit; method details were read from the author preprint, not claimed as a successful full OpenReview-page read.
ICLR 2022 venue is recorded separately from the 2021 preprint year.

academic_papers.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Ross, Stephane and Gordon, Geoffrey and Bagnell, Drew
academic_papers.venue_or_institution: Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics
claims_used_in_chapter: DAgger iteratively aggregates expert labels on states visited by a learned policy.
The analysis connects imitation learning to no-regret online learning under stated assumptions.
limitations: Author name Drew Bagnell follows the official PMLR citation metadata.
No DAgger theoretical guarantee is transferred to the local fixed-rollout suffix-replay scheme.

academic_papers.title: {ReAct}: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Yao, Shunyu and Zhao, Jeffrey and Yu, Dian and Du, Nan and Shafran, Izhak and Narasimhan, Karthik and Cao, Yuan
accessed_scope: ICLR 2023 conference-version metadata, abstract and introduction
claims_used_in_chapter: ReAct interleaves reasoning, actions and external observations.
The original paper studies both prompting and trajectory fine-tuning.
limitations: ReAct is not described as exclusively a prompting method.

academic_papers.title: {Reflexion}: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Shinn, Noah and Cassano, Federico and Gopinath, Ashwin and Narasimhan, Karthik and Yao, Shunyu
academic_papers.venue_or_institution: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
claims_used_in_chapter: Reflexion uses verbal feedback and episodic memory to influence subsequent attempts without weight updates in its core scheme.
limitations: No claim of a full-paper replication or complete experiment audit.

academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Madaan, Aman and Tandon, Niket and Gupta, Prakhar and Hallinan, Skyler and Gao, Luyu and Wiegreffe, Sarah and Alon, Uri and Dziri, Nouha and Prabhumoye, Shrimai and Yang, Yiming and Gupta, Shashank and Majumder, Bodhisattwa Prasad and Hermann, Katherine and Welleck, Sean and Yazdanbakhsh, Amir and Clark, Peter
academic_papers.venue_or_institution: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
claims_used_in_chapter: Self-Refine uses one model for generation, feedback and iterative refinement without additional training in its core scheme.
limitations: No claim of a full-paper replication or complete experiment audit.

academic_papers.title: {DeepSeekMath}: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Shao, Zhihong and Wang, Peiyi and Zhu, Qihao and Xu, Runxin and Song, Junxiao and Zhang, Mingchuan and Li, Y. K. and Wu, Y. and Guo, Daya
academic_papers.version_note: Version 2; author list follows this version. \url{https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03300v2}

academic_papers.authors_bibtex: Lewis, Patrick and Perez, Ethan and Piktus, Aleksandra and Petroni, Fabio and Karpukhin, Vladimir and Goyal, Naman and K{\"u}ttler, Heinrich and Lewis, Mike and Yih, Wen-tau and Rockt{\"a}schel, Tim and Riedel, Sebastian and Kiela, Douwe
